mentions.name: Shipping App Full Rewrite
mentions.description: A full rewrite of a two-year-old shipping app, migrating it away from an overkill high-security general-purpose application server. The new server exposes a much smaller API while keeping the existing SQL schema intact, with a client communication SDK underway, all designed to avoid disrupting the app's many users. An LLM was invaluable in enabling the rewrite.
mentions.problem: The app's previous server was a high-security, general-purpose application server that was way overkill for the app; the migration needs to proceed without interfering with the app's many users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm rewriting a shipping app, that is just over two years old.

This is a "full rewrite," because I need to migrate away from my previous server, which was developed as a high-security, general-purpose application server, and is way overkill for this app.
